title: Personnel Retrieval and Processing Technician (MGySgt to Pvt) FMOS, DC I&L
raw_text:
7. MOS 0472, Personnel Retrieval and Processing Technician (MGySgt to Pvt)
FMOS, DC I&L

    a. Summary. Personnel Retrieval and Processing Technicians perform
duties incident to the handling of human remains in both joint and single
service theaters of operations.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must be a volunteer.

            (2) Security requirement:     secret security clearance.

    c. Requirements. Complete the formal courses of instruction at the U.S.
Army Mortuary Affairs Center, Ft Lee, VA or complete a 7-month deployment in
a theater of operations during combat operations under the direct supervision
of school trained PRP personnel. In addition, the SNM must receive a letter
of recommendation from the OIC of the unit during the deployment.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (f), Logistics Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Funeral Attendants 39-4021.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

It includes the design, development, acquisition, storage, movement, distribution, maintenance, evacuation, and disposition of material, the movement, evacuation, and hospitalization of personnel, the acquisition or construction, maintenance, operation, and disposition of facilities, and the acquisition or furnishings of services. Prerequisites (1) Must be a volunteer. (2) Security requirement: secret security clearance. c. Requirements. nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
